Name: DIV
Scuffed RTL: A <= A / B; B <= A % B
Description: Divide A by B, remainder into B. If B = 0, A and B are unchanged

Name: SHL
Description: Shift A left by B bits (A = 0 if B >= 8)

Name: SHR
Description: Shift A right by B bits (A = 0 if B >= 8)

Name: GTE
Description: Check if greater than or equal

Name: LTE
Description: Check if less than or equal

Name: RET
Description: Return from subroutine. If the call stack is empty, only PC = PC + 1
